7A.title: Requirements for Firefighting Installations – For Residential Buildings

tiers.description: 24m+ height OR <24m with floor area 501–1000 m²

notes.1: If the building has kitchen, the protection level will be HL-2.
notes.2: If the building has basement to be protected with sprinklers, the protection level should comply with CL-3.
notes.3: If the building has EV parks in podium or basements, it should be protected with sprinklers and complying to CL-5.
notes.4: Rate of rise heat sensor/detection in EV parks. Smoke sensors in basements. CO sensors in ICE vehicle parks.
notes.5: If building height exceeds 60m, hydraulic calculations with multi-level pumping required. Pumps ≤12 bar shutoff.
notes.6: Pump pressure and quantity supported by hydraulic calculations.
notes.7: 2500 lpm at 10 bar common pumping and 255000 litre storage for cluster of max 5 buildings. Buildings ≥9m apart. EV parking triggers CL-5.
notes.8: Multi-level pumping for cluster buildings >45m. Water storage at every 45m above.
notes.9: Cluster >5 buildings requires another set of pumps and storage. Max 2 sets.
notes.10: Table 7K and Table 7M for water quantity calculations.

7B.title: Requirements for Firefighting Installations – For Educational Buildings

notes.1: If there are laboratories, AV/computer rooms, auditoriums, they should be protected with sprinkler. Protection level should comply with CL-3.
notes.2: If the building has basement to be protected with sprinklers, the protection level should comply with CL-3.
notes.3: If the building has EV parks in podium or basements, comply with CL-5.
notes.4: Rate of rise heat sensor in EV parks. Smoke sensors in basements. CO sensors in ICE parks.
notes.5: If building height exceeds 60m, multi-level pumping. Pumps ≤12 bar shutoff.
notes.6: Pump pressure and quantity supported by hydraulic calculations.
notes.7: 2500 lpm at 10 bar, 255000 litre storage for cluster of max 5 buildings.
notes.10: Table 7K and Table 7M for water quantity calculations.

7C.title: Requirements for Firefighting Installations – For Institutional Buildings

tiers.description: Height >15m OR ≤15m with area 501 m² and above

C-II_III.label: Custodial, Penal and Mental Institutions (C-II and C-III)

notes.1: Basement area or storage of oxygen/medical gases/gas fuel, laundry/linen/waste, transformer/HT rooms within building footprint or basement should be protected with sprinkler. Comply with CL-3.
notes.2: If the building has EV parks in podium or basements, comply with CL-5.
notes.3: If building height exceeds 60m, multi-level pumping. Pumps ≤12 bar shutoff.
notes.4: Protection should comply to supplementary protection per Table 9/10/11.
notes.5: Pump pressure and quantity supported by hydraulic calculations.
notes.6: Rate of rise heat sensor in EV parks. Smoke sensors in basements. CO sensors in ICE parks.
notes.7: 3785/2500 lpm at 10 bar, 350000/255000 litre storage for cluster of max 5 buildings ≤45m.
notes.10: If building height exceeds 30m, comply hydraulic calculations.
notes.11: Table 7K and Table 7M for water quantity calculations.

7D.title: Requirements for Firefighting Installations – For Assembly Buildings

notes.1: If the building has basement to be protected with sprinklers, comply with CL-3.
notes.2: If the building has EV parks in podium or basements, comply with CL-5.
notes.3: Live cooking kitchens, boiler/furnace rooms, laundry/linen/waste, transformer/HT rooms — sprinkler protection, comply with CL-4.
notes.4: Pump pressure and quantity supported by hydraulic calculations.
notes.5: Rate of rise heat sensor in EV parks. Smoke sensors in basements. CO sensors in ICE parks.
notes.6: 2500 lpm at 10 bar, 255000 litre storage for cluster of max 5 buildings.
notes.9: Table 7K and Table 7M for water quantity calculations.

7E.title: Requirements for Firefighting Installations – For Business Buildings

tiers.description: <15m height, floor area 1001 m² and above
15m+ height, floor area 1001 m² and above

notes.1: If the building has basement to be protected with sprinklers, comply with CL-3.
notes.2: If the building has EV parks in podium or basements, comply with CL-5.
notes.3: Protection should comply to supplementary protection per Table 9/10/11.
notes.4: If building height exceeds 60m, multi-level pumping. Pumps ≤12 bar shutoff.
notes.5: Pump pressure and quantity supported by hydraulic calculations.
notes.6: 2500 lpm at 10 bar, 255000 litre storage for cluster of max 5 buildings.
notes.7: 3785 lpm at 10 bar, 350000 litre storage for cluster of max 5 buildings.
notes.10: Entire building protected with sprinkler, comply with CL-5. IT/Data Hall clean agent gas suppression if racks without BBU.
notes.11: All internet data centres or hyper scales or colocation data centres comply with CL-6.
notes.12: IT/data hall racks with Li-ion BBU ≤20kWh/rack: wet/dry sprinkler/pre-action/water mist. BBU >20kWh: no water mist.
notes.13: Cluster of max 3 DC buildings: common pumping with additional diesel pump, double water storage.
notes.14: Li-ion energy storage >600kWh/floor: comply with CL-6.
notes.15: Li-ion BESS room: wet/single interlock pre-action sprinkler, entire room as assumed area of operation.
notes.16: Table 7K and Table 7M for water quantity calculations.

7F.title: Requirements for Firefighting Installations – For Mercantile Buildings

notes.1: Basement with sprinkler protection: comply with CL-3.
notes.2: EV parks in podium/basements: comply with CL-5.
notes.3: Rate of rise heat sensor in EV parks. Smoke/CO sensors in basements.
notes.4: Pump pressure and quantity supported by hydraulic calculations.
notes.5: 2500 lpm at 10 bar, 255000 litre storage for cluster ≤5 buildings.
notes.8: Table 7K and Table 7M for water quantity calculations.

7G.title: Requirements for Firefighting Installations – For Industrial Buildings

notes.1: If there is basement with sprinkler protection, comply with CL-3.
notes.2: EV parks in podium/basements: comply with CL-5.
notes.3: Rate of rise heat sensor in EV parks. Smoke/CO sensors in basements.
notes.4: Pump pressure and quantity supported by hydraulic calculations.
notes.7: Table 7K and Table 7M for water quantity calculations.

7H.title: Requirements for Firefighting Installations – For Storage Buildings

notes.1: Basement with sprinkler protection: comply with CL-3.
notes.3: Rate of rise heat sensor in EV parks. Smoke/CO sensors in basements.
notes.4: Table 7K and Table 7M for water quantity calculations.

7J.title: Requirements for Firefighting Installations – For Hazardous Buildings

notes.1: Protection should comply to supplementary protection per Table 9/10/11.
notes.2: Pump pressure and quantity supported by hydraulic calculations.
notes.3: Table 7K and Table 7M for water quantity calculations.
